text.jp:
この前、山賊の人たちが亡者に襲われててさ。
助けてあげたんだけど……
text.official_en:
A while back, I found bandits being attacked by the
risen dead. I helped them out, but...

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_カイ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
『金品奪うしか能がねえ奴助けて何になんだ』って
怒鳴られて、オレもついカッとなっちゃった。
text.official_en:
it upset a few people. They shouted, "Why are you
helping them? They're bandits!" I got so mad.

text.jp:
それで『人間、生きていたらなんでもできる』って
怒鳴り返したら、笑われたけど改心してくれたよ。
text.official_en:
So, I yelled back, "People can be anything if they're
still alive!" I got laughed at, but I made my point.

……闘技場で、
俺をモノケロースのようだと言った男がいた。
text.official_en:
There was a man at the colosseum who compared
me to a monoceros.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ベルトラン
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
『誇り高く、繊細で傷つきやすいが、強い』……
そう評価しての喩えだった。
text.official_en: "Fragile, but strong," he called me.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ベルトラン
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
当時は、たいした感慨も覚えなかったが……
不思議と記憶に残っているんだ。
text.official_en:
At the time, I didn't think much of it...but it's
lingered in my memory.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ベルトラン
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
今の俺なら……
ガブリエルに、なんと返すだろうな……
text.official_en:
Poor Gabriel. If I saw him now, I wonder how
I'd respond.

text.official_en: <TH>

逸楽とは何か……それを考えていた。
世界がどうなろうと、私は変わらない……
text.official_en:
What is the nature of pleasure? I was pondering this.
No matter what befalls the world, I do not change.

text.official_en: <TH>

ダグザの地がこんなになったせいで、
テフ豆の収穫量が激減してる。
text.official_en:
Thanks to the ongoing destruction of Dagda, the
coffee industry has all but collapsed.

Thanks to the ongoing destruction of Dagda, the
tef industry has all but collapsed.

で、商会の備蓄分を高く売りさばこうと思ったが、
バロールのせいで風評被害が出ていやがる。
text.official_en:
I'd planned to sell the company's remaining stock, but
again, Balor is getting in the way of a good thing.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_タリムーン

ダグザのテフを飲んだら早死するんだとさ。
たく、それが本当なら俺様がとっくに死んでるぜ。
text.official_en:
There's a rumor now that Dagdan coffee curses you
to die young! But I'd be long dead if that were true.
text.real_en:
There's a rumor now that Dagdan tef curses you

text.jp:
街の人々の話を聞いていると、
夜が不安だと言う方が多いのです。
text.official_en:
When I chat with people in the city, many say
they feel uneasy at night.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_オルヘル
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
またいつ亡者が襲って来るだろうかと思うと、
眠れないそうで……
text.official_en:
They can't sleep because they're scared of when
the risen dead might attack again.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_オルヘル
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
そういう時は、わたしがその人の側に
ついてあげるようにしています。
text.official_en:
When I see someone suffering like that, I try to
look after that person as long as I need to.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_オルヘル
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp: 安心して、眠りにつけるまで……
text.official_en:
They can often fall asleep once they feel calm
and comforted.

text.official_en: <TH>

text.jp:
救世主の名の下に、
兵も民も鼓舞されている。
text.official_en:
Your title of Promised One inspires soldiers and
citizens alike.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_セオドラ
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
民は“御使い”の伝説に惹かれているが、
兵らはその指揮と実力を信頼しているようだ。
text.official_en:
The citizens are drawn by the legend of the Herald,
while the soldiers admire your skilled leadership.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_セオドラ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
その想いを裏切ってはならん。
一度指導者として立ったなら、決して折れるなよ。
text.official_en:
But now that you have won their trust as a leader,
you must take great pains not to lose it.

text.official_en: <TH>

text.jp:
神威法王さまが死んで以来、薔薇祭……
“カエルスの薔薇”を選ぶ祭りは開かれていません。
text.official_en:
The Rose Pageant, where the Rose of Caelus is
chosen, hasn't been held since Solel's death.
text.real_en:
The Rose Pageant, where the Rose of Caelus is
chosen, hasn't been held since Sorell's death.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_レダ
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
カーラさまに聞いたんですけど、
戦争が終わっても開催する気はないそうです。
text.official_en:
I asked Kalla—it sounds like she doesn't intend to
hold any more, even after the war.
text.real_en:
I asked Cara-sama—it sounds like she doesn't intend to
hold any more, even after the war.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_レダ
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
……少し寂しいですが、あの方はあたしよりずっと
寂しい目をされていました。
text.official_en:
Which disappointed me. But of course, the sadness in
her eyes was greater.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_レダ
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
その上での決断なら何も言えませんよね。
できることと言えば彼女の望む曲を奏でるだけ……
text.official_en:
It's not as if I have any say in the matter. All I can do
is play whatever song she requests.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_アナトリア

text.jp:
かつてこの地に生きた、古代の人々……
彼らのことを想うと、複雑な気持ちになります。
text.official_en:
I get a bit emotional when thinking about the ancient
people who once lived here.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_アナトリア
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
僕はソロモンの王として、
過去を生きた彼らの記録を、未来へ伝えなければ。
text.official_en:
As queen of Solomon, I'll see to it that records of
them are passed on to the future.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_アナトリア
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
故に、この地で斃れるわけにはいきません。
必ず生きて勝利してみせます。
text.official_en:
I can't afford to die here. I have to survive, so I can
bring us victory.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ティアラ

text.jp:
後世に極力正確な情報が残るように、
亡者との戦いについて記録をしているんです。
text.official_en:
I'm keeping a record of battles with the risen dead so
future generations will have precise information.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ティアラ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
先人が書き記した史実と知識に
助けられて来ましたから。今度はあたしの番です。
text.official_en:
I read so much history that helped my planning. It's
my turn to pass knowledge forward.

戦闘の後に吐いちゃう癖、まだ治らないなあ。

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ピーテル

もう何年も戦ってるのに、
いい加減情けないよ。

And, given that I've been fighting for so many years,
I feel pathetic.

殺すのも、殺されるのも……
たくさん見て来たはずなのにね。

I've really seen a lot of things since that first fight.
People killing, being killed...

わたし……元々は、信仰心からっていうより、
お仕事として神官を選んだところがありました。
text.official_en:
I didn't become a priest because of my faith.
I did it because I needed a job.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ウルタンド
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

でも神殿がめちゃくちゃになった今では……
神官としての自覚がとても強くなったんです。
text.official_en:
Now that the temples are such a mess, I'm much
more aware of my duties as a priest.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ウルタンド
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

たとえ秩序が崩壊しても、アウロラ様に
胸を張れるような自分でいたい……って。
text.official_en:
Even with everything in a shambles, I want to be
able to hold my head up high in front of Aurora.

text.jp:
戦友たちに、酒の席に誘われることがあるんです。
昔は荒っぽい飲み方が苦手で遠慮してたんですが……
text.official_en:
Sometimes my fellow soldiers ask me out for a drink.
I don't like drunks, so I always tended to decline.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_マクシム
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
今は、そういうのもたまにはいいと思います。
酔って笑える時間は、かけがえのないものですから。
text.official_en:
Now I find that it's nice to have a tipple once in
a while—go out and share a laugh over a glass.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_マクシム
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
ただ……僕って酒に強いみたいで。
自然と面倒を見るほうになるんですよね。
text.official_en:
Though...I must have a pretty high tolerance, because
it always ends with me being the others' caretaker.

俺っち、戦うだけじゃなくて、

I've been helping! Not just in fights, but with repairs
and stuff too.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ゴライアス

I'm carrying heaps of materials, liftin' up workers
to reach roofs and stuff...

瓦礫が落っこちることもあったが、
俺っちが粉々にしたからみんな無事だぜ！
text.official_en:
and when rubble comes falling down, I smash it
into pieces. Gotta keep the others safe!

やれやれ……
漸く使用人を追い返すことに成功したぞ。
text.official_en:
Finally! Euhhh... There was a squire who was so
insistent about helping me.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ゲイツ

小僧でもあるまいし、戦場に立つことを

It's not as if I need someone fussing over me
in battle. I'm not some helpless old man.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ゲイツ

とはいえ、心配はありがたい。
奴に亡者の魔の手が及ばぬよう励むとしよう。
text.official_en:
Still, I suppose I appreciate his concern...so I'll have
to do my best to keep the risen dead's hands off him.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

ここ最近、詩人たちには新しい仕事が増えた。
墓に刻む碑文を創ることだ。
text.official_en:
Lately, it's fallen upon poets to craft epitaphs for
the graves of the fallen.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ダンテ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
死した兵士や民を忘れぬために、
生前の事績を歌い上げる詩を書き……
text.official_en:
So that the dead, soldiers and otherwise, are never
forgotten, we write verse to celebrate their deeds.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ダンテ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
死者の魂がその眠りを妨げられないよう、
祈りの言葉を彫るのさ……
text.official_en:
I only hope these words of prayer ward off any
disturbance in their rest.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ファビオ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
獣というのは実に脆いですね。
彼等は取るに足らない傷でも簡単に死にます。
text.official_en:
These insects are truly fragile. They perish so easily,
succumbing to even a glancing wound.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ファビオ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
死んでいただく分には構わないというか、
むしろ喜ばしいほどですが……
text.official_en:
Not that I mind, per se. It is, in fact, convenient in
some ways.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ファビオ
US EN person identifier agrees

今死ぬということはバロールに
力を与えるようなものですからね。
text.official_en:
Yet each of their deaths increases the strength of our
foe, Balor.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ファビオ
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
厄介な存在が更に厄介になるだけですから、
弱者は下がっていてもらいたいものです。
text.official_en:
As it makes what is already a troublesome situation
bleaker, I wish they could simply stand aside.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_エスメラルダ

text.jp:
海王ケートゥスって知ってる？
とんでもなく強い海の怪物なんだ。
text.official_en:
Ever heard of Cetus, the Sea Tyrant? The
massively powerful sea monster?
text.real_en:
Ever heard of Cetus, the Sea King? The
massively powerful sea monster?

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_エスメラルダ
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
あたい実は、ダーリンと一緒にあいつと戦って、
魔槍グラシーダを貰ったんだ。
text.official_en:
I actually got Grasitha, my spear, from fighting her
alongside Sweetie.
text.real_en:
I actually got Magic Spear Grasida, my spear, from fighting her
alongside Sweetie.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_エスメラルダ

text.jp:
あの槍を振るってるとさ、あいつが一緒に
戦ってくれてるみたいで力と勇気が湧くよ。
text.official_en:
Wielding it kinda makes me feel like Cetus is right
there with me. It's a big confidence booster!

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_エスメラルダ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
絶対に海で遭いたくはないけどね。
船乗りたちの間じゃけっこう有名だよ。
text.official_en:
If you've never met it, count yourself lucky. Every
sailor knows and fears that thing.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ウーシュラ
US EN person identifier agrees

どうしました？
私の顔に、何かついていますでしょうか。
text.official_en: Hm? Why are you looking at me like that?

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ウーシュラ
US EN person identifier agrees

……体調なら万全です。
ええ、なんらの支障もありません。
text.official_en:
If you're worried about me, don't be. I'll be fine,
I promise.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ウーシュラ
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
もう行ってください。
あなたのことは、皆が待ち侘びています。
text.official_en: Please, go. Everyone is waiting for you.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ウーシュラ
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
ですが、万が一のことがあれば……
頼みましたよ。救世主。
text.official_en:
If I end up needing you, trust me, I wouldn't call
on anyone else.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

時々だがよ。いい世の中になったと思う
自分がいるんだよな。
text.official_en:
You know... Sometimes I feel like the world is better
the way it is now.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_シモン
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
毎日戦いに明け暮れて、死線を潜り抜けてよ。
殺して生きてるだけでいい世界だ。
text.official_en:
Every day, we have to beat back death and fight for
our next breath. To me, that's a beautiful way to live.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_シモン
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

……おれが幸せを感じるってことは、
まともな連中はさぞつらいだろうぜ。
text.official_en:
But... If I feel happiness, that must mean normal
people are just suffering through this...

text.official_en: <TH>

生きることは苦しみばかりだというのに。
text.official_en:
To be revived when you die... What a tragedy.
Life is such suffering.

text.jp:
故に、せめてそれがしが倒した亡者は
弔ってやろうと、墓を建てようとしたのだが……
text.official_en:
Thinking upon this, I decided to mourn the dead
that I defeated by creating a grave for them.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ヨーカイ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
そこでも彼奴らに襲われてな。
墓石でまとめて殴り倒し、供養してやったわ。
text.official_en:
Then I was immediately attacked by them again!
So I took the headstone and clobbered them all.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_イオ
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
以前、蜂蜜酒を飲んでみたんだが、
あまり気分が良くならなかった。
text.official_en:
I tried drinking mead a while ago. It didn't make me
feel very good.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_イオ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
頭が妙にふわふわして、足に力が入れにくい。
もっと飲めば夢心地で楽しいと言われたが……
text.official_en:
I got light-headed and my legs grew wobbly. I was
told it'd be fun...like stumbling through a dream.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_イオ
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
俺は夢より、目の前の現実を楽しくしたいと思う。
そのためにも頭も体も鈍らせたくないんだ。
text.official_en:
But that was wrong—and I didn't like it. I'd rather
get through this life without stumbling.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ペペ
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
ダグシオンに元いた住人たちは、
ダグザの大釜で煮殺されてしまった……
text.official_en:
The entire citizenry of Dagsion was boiled down in
Dagda's cauldron... Death, for all of them...

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ペペ
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
……だがな！　前に下層区で世話になった幼子らが、
帝都に戻って来ていたのだ！
text.official_en:
But! We have learned that the children from lower
Dagsion who helped us have...returned to the city!

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ペペ
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
皆、無事に成長していた。王として嬉しいと
伝えたら、笑われてしまったがな！
text.official_en:
They all came back safely. We shared with them how
glorious and magnificent this news was to us!

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ペペ
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
再会に免じて、無礼は許してやった！
はっはっは！
text.official_en:
They laughed at our royal verbiage! Do they still not
know us to be a king? But we are glad they are safe.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ノクチュラ
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
亡者って厄介だけど、
稽古相手としてはぴったりだと思うんだ。
text.official_en:
The risen dead are trouble for everyone, but they
are the perfect training partners.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ノクチュラ
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
生きている人間相手だと、再起不能にしたり、
殺さないよう気をつけなきゃいけないだろ？
text.official_en:
You have to be so careful when you're training with
the living not to ruin them—or kill them!

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ノクチュラ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
その点、あいつらは傷つけても罪悪感が湧かないし、
手加減不要の全力を叩き込めるからね！
text.official_en:
But you can fight your hardest against the dead.
You can hit them with ALL you've got!

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ソフィア
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
久しぶりに『毎日はらぺこさん』って呼ばれたわ。
ふふ、あのおチビちゃんも大人っぽくなって……
text.official_en:
I got called the Grumbling Tummy for the first time
in a long time. Ha! That little kid's all grown up...

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ソフィア
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
でも……どうして会った途端に
『永久はらぺこ一等賞さん』に進化したのかしら？
text.official_en:
But I actually got called...Dagsion's Most
Grumbling Tummy. That seems a little too much.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ソフィア
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
確かにずっとお腹は鳴っていたけれど、
永久に一等賞じゃないはずよ！　はず……よね……？
text.official_en:
Yes, my stomach's always speaking up, but is it
worth calling out as "most" anything? Really!

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_カターニャ
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
長い戦の影響で、品物の質が落ちてきました。
私たちに相応しい物が少なくなっているようです。
text.official_en:
The quality of goods has dropped drastically due to
this war. There's nothing suitable for you and me!

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_カターニャ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
しかし救世主様、憂うことはありませんよ。
私と共にいる限り大丈夫です。
text.official_en:
Have no fear, Promised One. You'll be able to get
the very best soon enough, if you keep me near.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_カターニャ
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
一流の元には一流の品が集まると、
決まっていますからね！
text.official_en:
I know that if you gather enough sterling people
together, top-notch goods appear soon enough!

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ヌディーヌ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
馴染みのサラミス兵たちは、
見ない間に顔つきが変わっていました。
text.official_en:
My friends among the Saramis soldiers look
different than the last time I saw them.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ヌディーヌ
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
この地獄を生き延び、時に戦友を失い……
皆、戦士として成長したのでしょう。
text.official_en:
They've survived this nightmare. They've lost
comrades. They're growing tough as warriors.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ヌディーヌ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
喜ばしいことですが……
先達としては、複雑な心地です。
text.official_en:
It's a welcome sight for a mercenary like me. But
it's also hard to see younger people suffer.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ザーコネ
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
あっちのほうにあった村、
まだ民家がちゃんと残ってたな……
text.official_en:
One of the nearby villages had a few houses
left standing...

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ザーコネ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
山賊らしく、おれ様が一瞬で壊滅させてやりた……
いやいや、我慢だ我慢。
text.official_en:
A bandit's gotta do what a bandit's gotta do! Raze
the place! But yeah, I gotta hold back...maybe.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_マジーデ
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
亡者どもはいくらでも湧きやがるが、
無限に暴れられるマジーデ様には敵いやしねえ。
text.official_en:
The dead can rise all they want, but they're no
match for the great Majide on a rampage!

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_マジーデ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
つーわけで味方の雑魚は引っ込ませとけよ。
死んだら俺を崇められねえだろ？
text.official_en:
So hey, you keep your small-time allies back,
OK? They gotta stay alive to cheer me on!

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ベンディッツ
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
身を粉にして戦っておるというのに、なぜ、
ベンディッツ将軍の勇姿を描いた絵が出んのだ？
text.official_en:
I'm working myself to the bone. Why are there no
portraits glorifying General Benditz everywhere?!

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ベンディッツ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
敬愛の念を抱き、姿絵を懐にしたいと思う
若人が出てきてもおかしくないはずだぞ。
text.official_en:
Oh, at least one rosy youth ought to have captured
my likeness out of sheer admiration by now.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ベンディッツ
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
年を取ってはおるが、素晴らしく美形なのにな。
眼帯がいかんのか？　ふむう……
text.official_en:
Of course, I have a somewhat senior visage, but I
am handsome in profile! Is it the eye patch?

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_イニオニ
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
ウゴウの弓には、遺骸の髪の毛が
弦に使われていたと聞きました……
text.official_en:
I heard that Ugo's Bow used hair from those
terrible remains for its string.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_イニオニ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
髪だけであんな力を持つ武器が
出来るなんて……
text.official_en:
It's hard to believe that they made a weapon as
powerful as that using only some hair.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_イニオニ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
復活したバロールがどれほど強大か
考えるまでもありませんね……
text.official_en:
I...can't imagine how powerful a revived Balor
must be.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ジャスミン
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
こんな状況でも、
たまには笑うことも大事ですよ。
text.official_en:
Even at times like this, it's important to laugh
once in a while.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ジャスミン
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
鬱々していると、
思考が鈍ることもありますからね。
text.official_en:
When you're down in the dumps, your thinking
isn't at its best.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ジャスミン
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
あっはっはっはっは！！
……と笑うだけで気が楽になったりしますよ。
text.official_en:
So by laughing just like this—ha ha ha haaa!—you
can feel your whole self come back to you.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_アレキサンドラ
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
出会った頃のブーケパラスは
すごく小さかったんですよ。
text.official_en: Bucephalus was tiny when I first met him.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_アレキサンドラ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
それになかなか餌を食べなくて、
当時は心配したんですけど……
text.official_en:
He wouldn't eat much feed either, so I used to
worry about the little guy.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_アレキサンドラ
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
色んな餌を試してお気に入りを見つけてからは
ちゃんと食べてくれるようになったんです。
text.official_en:
But after we tried out a few different kinds of feed,
I found one he liked. Then he ate his fill.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_アレキサンドラ
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
まあ、同じ物ばかり食べさせてしまったので、
二人揃ってお医者様に怒られちゃいましたが……
text.official_en:
Though I did get a real scolding from a doctor, given
I was feeding him just that one thing all the time!

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_セントリオン
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
“鋼玉のセントリオン”として、
日々神殿の兵たちに稽古をつけております。
text.official_en:
As "Corundum Centurio," it is my duty to train the
temple's soldiers each and every day.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_セントリオン
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
無論、自主的な鍛練も、これまで一日たりとも
欠かしたことはありませぬ。私の誇りです。
text.official_en:
Naturally, I haven't skipped a single day of my own
training either. I'm quite proud of that.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_セントリオン
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
カストールなら……我が親友ならば、
『お前は本当に変わらん』と笑うでしょうが。
text.official_en:
If my old friend Castor were here, he'd tease me.
He'd say, "You never do change!"

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_キロイカ
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
何でこんなことになってるのに、
ヴァンダル商会って潰れねえんだ？
text.official_en:
How can the rest of the world get messed up...and
the Vandahl Trading Company still doesn't fail?!

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_キロイカ
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
やっぱり待つだけじゃ駄目なのか……
バロール様だって勝手に消えたりしねえんだし。
text.official_en:
I can't just wait around for that to happen. Even
Balor isn't going to take a tumble without a push.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_キロイカ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
世界が平和になったら、ちゃんと俺の手で
あの商会、潰そう。絶対に。
text.official_en:
So when this war ends, I'll go after that company
myself! I'll tear it down with my own hands!

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ヌッツォ
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
サラミスで、われらは安息の地を得られた。
彼の国の者たちとも徐々に打ち解けている。
text.official_en:
Saramis has been a haven for us. We're gradually
growing closer to its people.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ヌッツォ
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
……ハル・ハリ族は、他の部族との衝突こそあれど
友好的な交流は絶っていた。
text.official_en:
They are not, unfortunately, the only people with
whom the Har Hali have burned bridges.
text.real_en:
They are not, unfortunately, the only people with
whom the Har-Hari have burned bridges.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ヌッツォ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
ダマスカルの末裔同士の共存……
わが部族に、新たな道を示せたと信じたい。
text.official_en:
I want to believe I can show my people a new way—
a path of coexistence between children of Damascar.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_フォトナ
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
「天刻」とはすなわち「天獄」に通ず。
おぬしらから見れば広大に思える天ですらも、
text.official_en: The eternal life of a god is an eternal prison.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_フォトナ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
巨大な因果によって閉じ込められる檻のような
ものに過ぎぬということじゃ。
text.official_en:
Though they seem vast to you, even the heavens
are a cage formed of powerful causality.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_フォトナ
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
悠久を生きるということは、それだけの時間、
顕世に縛られ制約を受け続けるということ。
text.official_en: To live eternally is to remain bound to this world.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_フォトナ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
そして、自分が長く生きるほどに別れが……
見送らなければならぬ者たちが増えてゆく。
text.official_en:
The longer one lives, the more lives you see end.
'Tis a never-ending procession of farewells.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_フォトナ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
この先、あらゆる者や事象が吾や彼女を
置いて遠い所に行ってしまうのじゃろう。
text.official_en:
In time, all things—all people—will travel to a far-off
land where she and I cannot follow.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_フォトナ
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
そう、吾々は存在することで既に、
囚われておるのじゃ。
text.official_en: We are imprisoned by our existence.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_フォトナ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
自由など、己で見出さない限り決して
得られることもない幻に過ぎんということじゃ。
text.official_en:
Freedom that is not won for oneself is a fleeting
dream that remains ever elusive.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_コウカ
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
私は、セオドラ女王をはじめとする
ダマスカルの末裔たちには親近感を抱いている。
text.official_en:
I feel a kinship with Queen Theodora and the other
children of Damascar.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_コウカ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
かつて生き別れた、幼かった我が子の
忘れ形見のように思えてな。
text.official_en:
In them, I see the son who was torn from me so
long ago.

text.jp: <NCA>確かにそうだ
text.official_en: <NCA>"I can see why."

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_コウカ
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
……もしもあの時、無事にキュベレーの地に
たどり着き、生き延びていたとしても、
text.official_en:
Even if he survived and found refuge in Cybele,
my son was an ordinary human.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_コウカ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
あの子は普通の人間だ。とうの昔に
寿命を迎えてしまっているだろう。
text.official_en:
He would have reached the end of his natural life
many years ago.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_コウカ
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
だが、あの子の血と遺志を継いだ者が今も
存在しているかも知れないと思うと――
text.official_en:
But then I think of how his bloodline—those who
inherited his nature—might still be with us.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_コウカ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
少し嬉しいし、励みになる気がするんだ。
ただの願望なのかもしれないがな。
text.official_en:
I find it an encouraging thought...even if it is merely
wishful thinking.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_トロイア
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
このダグシオンも、

text.official_en:
Ten years ago, I was a gladiator, and I had Gabriel
looking out for me.

俺は力はあったけど、気が弱くてな。

text.official_en:
I was strong, but my heart wasn't in it. He gave me
some farewell money and sent me back home.

text.jp:
あの人、普段はすげー金にがめついのにだぜ？
根は本当に優しい人だったんだよ……
text.official_en:
Everyone will tell you how miserly he could be.
But deep down, he was generous at heart.

text.official_en: <TH>

text.jp:
熊を狩れば肉は食えるし毛皮も使えるが、
亡者は何も使えないから嫌だね。
text.official_en:
Hunting bears gets you meat and fur, but hunting the
risen dead gets you nothing. I do it anyway, though.

text.jp:
奴らはただ、命を奪いに来るだけ。
そんなもんに黙ってやられてたまるもんかい。
text.official_en:
They only exist to kill us. You can't take that kind
of thing lying down.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

text.jp:
やっぱり俺は、槍の鍛錬をするより
走り込みをしていたいなあ。
text.official_en: I'd rather be doing distance running than spear drills.

text.jp:
そのほうが、逃げるのに役立つ気がするんだよ。
無理して亡者に立ち向かうより生き残れそうだろ？
text.official_en:
Escaping the risen dead would be way more useful
than making a futile stand against them.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

text.jp:

仕入れるのも難しかったんですよね。
text.official_en:
Until a little while ago, it was tough to get enough
feed for horses and war elephants.

text.jp:
今よりもひどく飢えにあえいでいた頃は、
弱い子から殺して食べるしかありませんでした……
text.official_en:
When the famine was at its worst, we had no choice
but to slaughter the weaker ones to feed ourselves.

text.jp:
自分たちが生きるためとは言え、楽に死なせる
以外に何もできなかったのは本当に辛いです……
text.official_en:
It was necessary, but it hurt that the most I could do
for them was to give them a painless death.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

text.jp:

私が食べなければ、兵士さんのご飯が増えるもん。
text.official_en:
I'm so hungry...but I have to bear it. If I don't eat,
there'll be more food for the soldiers.

text.jp:
あの人たちには、頑張って敵を倒してもらうから。
戦えない私にできることは、それくらい……
text.official_en:
If I can't fight, taking care of the ones putting their
lives on the line for us is the least I can do.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

text.jp:

不敬ではないか、という主張をしました。
text.official_en:
When the statue of Lord Solel was built, I said it was
disrespectful to reproduce the face of a god.
text.real_en:
When the statue of Lord Sorell was built, I said it was
disrespectful to reproduce the face of a god.

text.jp:
結果として私の意見は通らなかったのですが、
今はそれで良かったのだと思います。
text.official_en: Few agreed with me, and now I'm glad they didn't.

text.jp:
像があるおかげで、太陽神ソレル様のご尊顔を
皆が忘れずに済むのですから。
text.official_en:
Now that statue will always stand as a reminder of
Lord Solel, our revered Sunbearer.
text.real_en:
Now that statue will always stand as a reminder of
Lord Sorell, our revered Sunbearer.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

text.jp:

神様たちはどうやって神様になったんだろうね。
text.official_en:
I've wondered something for a while now...how did
we come to see the gods as gods?

text.jp:
まあ、カーラ様みたいな美しい女神を前にすると、
自然と跪きたくはなるけどさ。
text.official_en:
I suppose when you're face to face with divine
beauty like Kalla's, the natural instinct is to kneel.
text.real_en:
I suppose when you're face to face with divine
beauty like Cara's, the natural instinct is to kneel.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

お願いします、どうか私の孫をお救いください！
text.official_en: Gods! Oh gods! Save my grandchild, I beg you!

text.jp:
先日、村を襲っていた亡者……
あれは間違いなくあの子でした。
text.official_en:
The other day, when risen dead attacked the village...
I'm certain I saw my granddaughter among them.

text.jp:
虫も殺せないような、優しい子だったのです！
それが、あんな亡者に成り果てる、だなんて……！
text.official_en:
She was such a sweet child who wouldn't hurt a fly!
For her to end up as one of those abominations is...

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

text.jp:

みんなで力を合わせてどうにか耕してるよ。
text.official_en:
The fields are all ruined thanks to the demon god,
but we're all pitching in to try to cultivate them.

text.jp:
種を撒いておけば、あたしが死んだとしても、
子供たちの飯になってくれるだろ。
text.official_en:
Even if I die, the seeds I sow today might end up
feeding my children.

text.official_en: <TH>

text.official_en:

was guaranteed to protect me from any monster.

text.jp:
これが板に飾りをつけただけでやんの！
すぐ壊れちまったよ。

But it was just a board with a painted-on design.
Fell apart after taking a couple of hits.

it's dangerous.

text.jp:

救世主様、なにか面白いお話してー！

But it's so boring here! Promised One, tell me a
good story!

The grown-ups are all fed up. They're mad the war
has been going on for longer than five years.

I'm eight, so I don't really remember before the war.
What's peace like?

text.jp:

text.official_en:
My big sis is a great ornius rider! She's tough,
she's carefree, and she's terrific.

text.jp:
孤立した村の救援に向かうって言って、
もう何か月も戻って来ないけど……
text.official_en:
Last I saw her, she was heading out to save an
isolated village. But that was months ago...

text.jp:
きっと、どこかで迷っちまってるだけだ。
だって簡単に死ぬわけ……ねえんだから。
text.official_en:
She probably just got lost on her way back. I really
don't think she'd up and die so easily.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

text.jp:
私はかつて靴職人として、ウルカ郡あたりでは
それなりに名を馳せていました。
text.official_en:
Before the war, I had some modest fame as a
shoemaker in Urka.
text.real_en:
Before the war, I had some modest fame as a
shoemaker in Uruka.

text.jp:
しかし、戦禍で材料が手に入らなくなり、
店を畳みました。いつかは再開したいものです。
text.official_en:
But the war made materials scarce, so I had to close
up shop. I'd like to reopen someday if I can.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

text.jp:
船に乗り、海路からこのダグシオンに来る、
避難民の方は多くいらっしゃいます。
text.official_en:
There are quite a lot of refugees here who all got on
a boat and came to Dagsion by sea.

text.jp:
しかしそれは、敵も同じやり方で侵入できることを
意味します。警戒を怠るわけにはいきませんね。
text.official_en:
But I worry that our enemies will get the same idea.
We have to keep our eyes open.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

text.jp:
私は、長く続く戦乱に嫌気が差し、
軍を脱走した腰抜けです。
text.official_en:
I'm a coward who got fed up with this never-ending
war and deserted my squadron.

text.jp:
しかし、上官に厳しく鍛えられたこの体は、
未だ戦う術を忘れていないようで……
text.official_en:
But I haven't forgotten how to fight. Nothing my
superiors drilled into me has gone away.

text.jp:
避難民を亡者から守ることが出来、感謝されました。
こんな私にも、まだやれることはあるのですね。
text.official_en:
Now I protect the refugees from the risen dead. They
seem grateful, so maybe deserting wasn't so bad.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

text.jp:
自分は訓練を受けた正規の軍人ではありません。
死体から装備を剥ぎ取っただけの素人です。
text.official_en:
I'm no regular soldier with formal training. Just some
guy who took a bit of equipment off a corpse.

text.jp:
しかし、この格好で立っているだけで、
子供たちが安心すると言うものですから。
text.official_en:
But standing around in this getup makes the kids
feel safer.

text.jp:
すっかり引っ込みがつかなくなってしまいました。
敵をやっつけるのは、救世主様にお任せします！
text.official_en:
I'm in way too deep now to back out...but I'll leave
the real foe-smiting to you, Promised One.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

text.jp:
世界がどれほど荒れようと、人が生きている限り、
需要というものは存在する……
text.official_en:
No matter how dismal this world gets, as long as
anyone's left alive, then demand will exist.

text.jp:
ならば、それに供給をしてみせるのが商人よ！
どこにだって出向いて、商品をお届けするんだから！
text.official_en:
And merchants will be the ones to supply them!
We'll go anywhere to close a deal!

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

text.jp:
貴族の嗜みとして、剣闘試合を眺めていた頃は、
見世物の戦士たちを馬鹿にしていたもんさ。
text.official_en:
A favorite pastime of nobles was to watch bouts in
the arena, mocking those who fought for spectacle.

text.jp:
でも、彼らはそんな僕を助けてくれた。
その腕っ節で、亡者を倒してくれたんだ。
text.official_en:
But the same ones we laughed at were the ones who
saved us when the risen dead attacked.

text.jp:
僕がどんな目で見ていたかも知っていただろうに。
……自分が恥ずかしいよ。
text.official_en:
Knowing full well how we used to mock them,
no doubt. I'm ashamed.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

text.jp:
私は、こうやってときどき
この場所を訪れています。
text.official_en: I visit here every so often.

text.jp:
ここに居れば……４年前に生き別れた
あの人と再会できるような気がして……
text.official_en:
I still feel like maybe...maybe I'll see her again after
we were separated four years ago.
